import asyncio
import os
import queue
import threading

import aiohttp
import sounddevice as sd


OPENAI_REALTIME_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime?model=gpt-4o-realtime-preview-2024-12-17"


class MicrophoneTranscriptStreamer:
    def __init__(self, sample_rate: int = 16000, channels: int = 1, blocksize: int = 1024):
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.channels = channels
        self.blocksize = blocksize
        self._audio_queue: queue.Queue[bytes] = queue.Queue()
        self._stop_event = threading.Event()

    def _audio_callback(self, indata, frames, time_info, status):
        if status:
            pass
        self._audio_queue.put(bytes(indata))

    async def stream(self):
        api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
        if not api_key:
            raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")

        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
            "OpenAI-Beta": "realtime=v1",
        }

        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(headers=headers) as session:
            async with session.get(OPENAI_REALTIME_API_URL) as ws_response:
                ws = ws_response._protocol._payload_writer.transport.get_extra_info("socket")
                if ws is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("Failed to establish realtime connection")

        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

        def capture_audio():
            with sd.InputStream(
                samplerate=self.sample_rate,
                channels=self.channels,
                blocksize=self.blocksize,
                dtype="int16",
                callback=self._audio_callback,
            ):
                while not self._stop_event.is_set():
                    self._stop_event.wait(0.1)

        capture_thread = threading.Thread(target=capture_audio, daemon=True)
        capture_thread.start()

        while not self._stop_event.is_set():
            chunk = await loop.run_in_executor(None, self._audio_queue.get)
            if not chunk:
                continue
            transcript = chunk.decode("latin1", errors="ignore")
            yield transcript

    def stop(self):
        self._stop_event.set()


async def main():
    streamer = MicrophoneTranscriptStreamer()
    async for transcript in streamer.stream():
        print(transcript, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

import os
import sys
import threading

import pyaudio
from deepgram import DeepgramClient, LiveOptions, LiveTranscriptionEvents


def main():
    api_key = os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is required")

    language = os.getenv("TRANSCRIPTION_LANGUAGE", "en-US")
    sample_rate = int(os.getenv("AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE", "16000"))
    channels = 1
    chunk_size = 1024

    client = DeepgramClient(api_key)
    connection = client.listen.live.v("1")

    done = threading.Event()

    def on_open(_, __, ***kwargs):
        pass

    def on_transcript(_, result, **kwargs):
        alt = result.channel.alternatives[0]
        transcript = alt.transcript.strip()
        if transcript:
            print(transcript)

    def on_error(_, error, **kwargs):
        print(error, file=sys.stderr)

    def on_close(_, **kwargs):
        done.set()

    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Open, on_open)
    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_transcript)
    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Error, on_error)
    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Close, on_close)

    options = LiveOptions(
        model="nova-2",
        language=language,
        punctuate=True,
        interim_results=True,
        smart_format=True,
        encoding="linear16",
        sample_rate=sample_rate,
        channels=channels,
    )

    connection.start(options)

    pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    stream = pa.open(
        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
        channels=channels,
        rate=sample_rate,
        input=True,
        frames_per_buffer=chunk_size,
    )

    try:
        while not done.is_set():
            data = stream.read(chunk_size, exception_on_overflow=False)
            connection.send(data)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        try:
            connection.finish()
        finally:
            stream.stop_stream()
            stream.close()
            pa.terminate()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import asyncio
import os
from typing import AsyncIterator, Iterable

import aiohttp


OPENAI_TRANSCRIBE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions"
OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe"


class OpenAIAudioChunkStreamer:
    def __init__(self, source: AsyncIterator[bytes], chunk_size: int = 4096):
        self._source = source
        self._chunk_size = chunk_size

    async def stream(self) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        buffer = bytearray()
        async for chunk in self._source:
            if not chunk:
                continue
            buffer.extend(chunk)
            while len(buffer) >= self._chunk_size:
                yield bytes(buffer[: self._chunk_size])
                del buffer[: self._chunk_size]
        if buffer:
            yield bytes(buffer)


async def transcribe_chunk(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, audio_chunk: bytes, filename: str) -> str:
    data = aiohttp.FormData()
    data.add_field("model", OPENAI_MODEL)
    data.add_field("file", audio_chunk, filename=filename, content_type="application/octet-stream")
    data.add_field("response_format", "text")
    async with session.post(OPENAI_TRANSCRIBE_URL, data=data) as response:
        response.raise_for_status()
        return await response.text()


async def stream_audio_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
    streamer = OpenAIAudioChunkStreamer(source)

    async with aiohttp.ClientSession(headers=headers) as session:
        index = 0
        async for chunk in streamer.stream():
            index += 1
            transcript = await transcribe_chunk(session, chunk, f"chunk-{index}.wav")
            yield transcript


async def _demo_source() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
    for part in (b"audio-part-1", b"audio-part-2", b"audio-part-3"):
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        yield part


async def main() -> None:
    async for item in stream_audio_chunks(_demo_source()):
        print(item, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
import os
import queue
import threading

import aiohttp
import sounddevice as sd


OPENAI_REALTIME_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime?model=gpt-4o-realtime-preview-2024-12-17"


class MicrophoneTranscriptStreamer:
    def __init__(self, sample_rate: int = 16000, channels: int = 1, blocksize: int = 1024):
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.channels = channels
        self.blocksize = blocksize
        self._audio_queue: queue.Queue[bytes] = queue.Queue()
        self._stop_event = threading.Event()

    def _audio_callback(self, indata, frames, time_info, status):
        if status:
            pass
        self._audio_queue.put(bytes(indata))

    async def stream(self):
        api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
        if not api_key:
            raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")

        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
            "OpenAI-Beta": "realtime=v1",
        }

        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(headers=headers) as session:
            async with session.get(OPENAI_REALTIME_API_URL) as ws_response:
                ws = ws_response._protocol._payload_writer.transport.get_extra_info("socket")
                if ws is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("Failed to establish realtime connection")

        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

        def capture_audio():
            with sd.InputStream(
                samplerate=self.sample_rate,
                channels=self.channels,
                blocksize=self.blocksize,
                dtype="int16",
                callback=self._audio_callback,
            ):
                while not self._stop_event.is_set():
                    self._stop_event.wait(0.1)

        capture_thread = threading.Thread(target=capture_audio, daemon=True)
        capture_thread.start()

        while not self._stop_event.is_set():
            chunk = await loop.run_in_executor(None, self._audio_queue.get)
            if not chunk:
                continue
            transcript = chunk.decode("latin1", errors="ignore")
            yield transcript

    def stop(self):
        self._stop_event.set()


async def main():
    streamer = MicrophoneTranscriptStreamer()
    async for transcript in streamer.stream():
        print(transcript, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
